item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00128","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C06","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 is a close drafting analogue: both directives amend an earlier order governing an interdepartmental body's membership, use the same amendatory formula, and specify the added departmental representation.
